description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client for each request. The value can contain only ASCII characters.

title.zh: 对服务进行预发布操作

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier pre-launch-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-f7024a22ea5149xxxxxx --client-token 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --region cn-hangzhou
